entities.name: Jamal Kanlıbaeva
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jamal Musagalikyzy Kanlıbaeva was a Kazakh and Soviet scientist, doctor of technical sciences (1965), professor (1968), corresponding member of the Academy of Sciences of the Kazakh SSR (1970). Her main activity was studying the movement of rocks with the help of radioactive isotopes.

entities.name: Jamal Kanlıbaeva
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jamal Musagalikyzy Kanlıbaeva was a Kazakh and Soviet scientist, doctor of technical sciences (1965), professor (1968), corresponding member of the Academy of Sciences of the Kazakh SSR (1970). Her main activity was studying the movement of rocks with the help of radioactive isotopes.
